notes: Access: robots.txt (Tier 1 HTTP fetch) allows crawling (/collections/ paths generally open, only admin/cart/checkout/search/sort_by/policies disallowed; no Claude-specific disallow). Discovery method: downloaded the full Shopify collections sitemap (sitemap_collections_1.xml, 602 collection URLs) and keyword-scanned it for christmas, xmas, halloween, easter, valentine, mother/father's day, diwali, thanksgiving, new-year, hanukkah, advent, nativity, cracker, festive, seasonal, gift. Found exactly 5 seasonal-named collections: christmas-advent-nativity, christmas-crackers, christmas-decorations, christmas-tree-decorations, easter-decorations. No Halloween, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Diwali, Thanksgiving or New Year collection exists anywhere in the taxonomy (also checked spook/pumpkin/witch/ghost/heart/romance/for-mum/for-dad/diya/turkey/nye variants - none found). A 6th match, /collections/seasonal, is titled 'Seasonal Special Offers' - a storewide sale/offers page, not a genuine category, excluded per rules. This site is a Shopify store whose collection PLPs render products client-side via an Algolia InstantSearch widget (Tier 1 static HTML has zero product markup), so Tier 2 (Playwright/CDP) was used to get the real, live, site-reported product counts by capturing the actual Algolia network response (shopify_prod_products index, nbHits field, hitsPerPage 24/nbPages 1 confirming totals, not truncated pages) for each of the 5 candidate pages, rather than trusting the Shopify products.json endpoint (which returned stale/mismatched counts, e.g. 70 for crackers vs 11 live) or raw DOM link-scraping (which double-counted a generic 30-item 'Recommended Products' fallback carousel that appears on every collection page regardless of real content, including on genuinely empty pages showing an explicit on-page 'Sorry, we found no results' message). Verified live results: (1) christmas-crackers - nbHits 11, sampled titles are genuine crackers ('6 Lakeland Nutcracker Curling Game Crackers', '6 The Traitors Christmas Crackers', 'Large FYO White Cable Print Crackers') - INCLUDED. (2) christmas-decorations - nbHits 17, sampled titles are genuine Christmas decor ('New Empire Fir Pre-Lit Christmas Tree 7ft', 'Lakeland Wooden Nutcracker Nesting Decorations', 'Tis The Season Lantern LED') - INCLUDED. (3) christmas-advent-nativity (breadcrumb: Seasonal > Decorations > Christmas Advent & Nativity, h1 'Christmas Advent & Nativity') - live Algolia nbHits 0, page displays 'Sorry, we found no results for' with only the generic unrelated fallback carousel (dehumidifiers, sprinkles, etc.) - currently empty of live stock (checked 2026-09-04, pre-Christmas-season; Shopify's raw products.json still lists 12 products assigned to this collection object but none are surfacing in the live storefront search/browse experience) - EXCLUDED, not a genuine currently-browsable PLP. (4) christmas-tree-decorations (h1 'Christmas Tree Decorations') - live Algolia nbHits 0, same 'no results' + generic fallback pattern - EXCLUDED. (5) easter-decorations (h1 'Easter Decorations, Hanging & Table Decor') - live Algolia nbHits 0, same 'no results' + generic fallback pattern - EXCLUDED. No Mother's/Father's Day content-verification was needed since no such collections exist at all. Net result: 2 genuine, currently-live, content-verified seasonal rows (both Christmas kitchen/home-decor categories, matching the site's UK kitchenware/home-decor focus); 3 taxonomy slugs exist but are presently empty pre-season placeholders and were excluded rather than listed with qty 0.
